title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR7-A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Front‑of‑board (FOB) recording delivers crisp, open sound and the concert bursts with high energy, highlighted by Jack Straw, Terrapin Station, and a soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The FOB mix on this Nakamichi 700 tape is exceptionally clear – brilliant mids, punchy highs, solid bass and crystal‑clear cymbal definition that lets the dual drummers shine. Musically the show rides a strong wave from a stadium‑rock opener with Jack Straw through a groove‑finding second set featuring Terrapin Station, Throwing Stones, Not Fade Away and an emotional Morning Dew, ending with a double encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Detailed positive review praises both the high‑energy performance and excellent front‑of‑board sound quality; weighting favors show (70%) and recording (30%), yielding a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FOB mix captures a sweet spot with open, balanced mids, highs and bass; PA is loud and clear; cymbal (ride bell) definition is outstanding; overall crisp and clean sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set blends new and classic material with strong playing; second set finds groove, building to a powerful finish and double encore.

band_member_comments.Drums: Cymbal definition praised, especially ride bell clarity for the two drummers.
